readings: For each invoice_number in Invoice_Line_Items, compute its cost ratio as the average of derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost over its lines, skipping lines where the ratio is NULL (including lines where derived_total_cost is 0 or NULL). Give the number of line items as the count of ALL Invoice_Line_Items rows for that invoice, including rows whose ratio is missing. Give the relative ratio as the invoice's cost ratio divided by the average of the invoice-level cost ratios across all invoices, ignoring invoices whose cost ratio is NULL. Return rows only if that overall average is not NULL. Sort by relative ratio descending with NULLs last, keep the top 10, and do not round.

For each invoice_number in Invoice_Line_Items, compute its cost ratio as the average of derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost over its lines, skipping lines where the ratio is NULL (including lines where derived_total_cost is 0 or NULL). Give the number of line items as the count of only those lines that have a non-missing ratio, so it is the number of lines actually used in the average. Give the relative ratio as the invoice's cost ratio divided by the average of the invoice-level cost ratios across all invoices, ignoring invoices whose cost ratio is NULL. Return rows only if that overall average is not NULL. Sort by relative ratio descending with NULLs last, keep the top 10, and do not round.
queries:
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         COUNT(*) AS num_line_items,
         AVG(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio
  FROM inv
  WHERE cost_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT inv.invoice_number,
       inv.num_line_items,
       inv.cost_ratio,
       inv.cost_ratio / overall.avg_ratio AS relative_ratio
FROM inv
CROSS JOIN overall
WHERE overall.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
WITH inv AS (
  SELECT invoice_number,
         AVG(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / derived_total_cost) AS cost_ratio,
         COUNT(derived_product_cost * 1.0 / derived_total_cost) AS line_item_count
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM inv WHERE cost_ratio IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT inv.invoice_number,
       inv.cost_ratio,
       inv.line_item_count,
       inv.cost_ratio / overall.avg_ratio AS relative_ratio
FROM inv, overall
WHERE overall.avg_ratio IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio IS NULL, relative_ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
